goal: Build muxFinder, a macOS menu bar app that finds tmux sessions on the user's Macs and attaches them in iTerm2 via tmux -CC.

phases.title: Package skeleton, process runner, quoting and validation
phases.summary: Sets up the Swift package, a safe process runner, shell quoting, input validation, app paths and a diagnostics log.

phases.title: tmux discovery: probe, parser, identity, error classification
phases.summary: Lists tmux sessions on a host with a read-only probe, parses them strictly and classifies SSH and tmux failures.

phases.title: Native iTerm2 API client
phases.summary: Talks to iTerm2 over its Unix-socket WebSocket API; split into 3a (wire layer) and 3b (transport and client), both done.

phases.title: iTerm2 wire layer: protobuf codec, typed messages, golden fixtures
phases.summary: Encodes and decodes the iTerm2 API protobuf messages muxFinder needs, checked byte-for-byte against golden fixtures.

phases.title: iTerm2 transport and client: WebSocket, cookie, API client, probe
phases.summary: Connects to iTerm2 over its Unix-socket WebSocket with a cookie and exposes the API calls to the app and probe.

phases.title: Integration proof, local: attach, native tabs and splits, detach, reattach
phases.summary: Proves the local attach workflow end to end; split into 4a (launch layer), 4b (coordinator) and 4c (real proof), all done.

phases.title: Launch layer and helper: request files, guard, muxfinder-launch
phases.summary: Hands attach requests to a launch helper through private files and checks the session is unchanged before attaching.

phases.title: Attach coordinator and probe commands
phases.summary: Attaches, confirms, focuses and detaches a local session in iTerm2, with hermetic tests and the e2e-local harness.

phases.title: Real local proof
phases.summary: Runs e2e-local against real iTerm2 and tmux; four passing runs, a 10 s helper lifetime, and the final integration proof.

phases.title: Integration proof over SSH, and existing-attachment detection
phases.summary: Proves SSH attach and existing-attachment detection; split into 5a (local detection and focus) and 5b (remote attach), both done.

phases.title: Existing-attachment detection, local
phases.summary: Maps iTerm2 tmux connections to sessions, focuses an existing attachment instead of opening a tab, and detaches by session.

phases.title: Remote attach over SSH
phases.summary: Attaches remote sessions in iTerm2 over ssh -t with a 20 s still-waiting budget; e2e-remote passed 11/11 twice on the final tree.

phases.title: Session operations: create, move here, disappeared sessions
phases.summary: Creates sessions, moves attached sessions here and handles vanished ones; split into 6a (done) and 6b (awaiting real runs).

phases.title: New session and vanished sessions
phases.summary: Creates sessions safely and reports vanished ones; e2e-local 15/15 and e2e-remote 16/16 passed on the final tree.

phases.title: Move here
phases.summary: Move here is built, reviewed and fixed; awaiting its real e2e-remote and final-tree e2e-local runs (iTerm2 thread gate).

phases.title: Host configuration and refresh engine
phases.summary: Stores hosts and refreshes their sessions; split into 7a (host configuration) and 7b (refresh engine), both done.

phases.title: Host configuration
phases.summary: Saves hosts.json safely with backups of anything it replaces, enforces one This Mac and suggests SSH config hosts.

phases.title: Refresh engine
phases.summary: Refreshes every host concurrently with backoff, sleep and wake handling, and live or stale snapshots.

phases.title: Menu bar app and popover
phases.summary: Shows hosts and sessions in a menu bar popover.

phases.title: Settings, onboarding, launch at login, diagnostics
phases.summary: Adds the settings window, first-run onboarding, launch at login and a diagnostics view.

phases.title: Attach UX: open, focus, new session, move here, detach
phases.summary: Wires the popover actions to attach, focus, create, move and detach sessions.

phases.title: Persistent Work profiles
phases.summary: Generates the muxFinder iTerm2 dynamic profile for persistent work sessions.

phases.title: Packaging, documentation, acceptance run
phases.summary: Builds the signed app bundle, writes the docs and runs the final acceptance checks.
